config.elytra-vario.showLadder.tooltip: Show or hide this instrument. The master HUD switch still applies. The toggle key changes and saves this setting.
config.elytra-vario.ladderGlidingOnly.to: Show only while elytra gliding. This setting persists while the instrument is hidden.
config.elytra-vario.ladderOpacity.toolti: Multiplies rung and label opacity; marker colors are independent.
config.elytra-vario.showLadderLabels.too: Show numeric labels on the major pitch rungs.
config.elytra-vario.ladderCenterGap.tool: Half-width of the crosshair gap; also positions pitch markers.
config.elytra-vario.ladderFineLength.too: Length on each side of the center gap.
config.elytra-vario.ladderMinorLength.to: Length on each side of the center gap.
config.elytra-vario.ladderMajorLength.to: Length on each side of the center gap.
config.elytra-vario.ladderPrimeLength.to: Length on each side of the center gap.
config.elytra-vario.ladderHorizonExtra.t: Length on each side of the center gap.
config.elytra-vario.ladderBandFractionUp: Percentage of the distance from screen center to the top edge. Also applies to markers; does not change field of view.
config.elytra-vario.ladderBandFractionDo: Percentage of the distance from screen center to the bottom edge. Shared by markers.
config.elytra-vario.showFineTicks.toolti: Show fine pitch ticks near the camera pitch.
config.elytra-vario.ladderFineRangeDegre: Angular distance from the camera pitch over which fine ticks fade out.
config.elytra-vario.ladderFadeFraction.t: Outer portion of the ladder band where rungs and markers fade out.
config.elytra-vario.showMarkers.tooltip: Show or hide this instrument. The master HUD switch still applies. The toggle key changes and saves this setting.
config.elytra-vario.markersGlidingOnly.t: Show only while elytra gliding. This setting persists while the instrument is hidden.
config.elytra-vario.showLookaheadPitch.t: Pitch from -89° to +89° that maximizes total-energy change (altitude + speed² / (2 × gravity)) over the lookahead while holding pitch and yaw constant. Searches whole degrees, then refines the best result. Uses current velocity, yaw, and gravity with free-flight elytra physics; excludes rockets, collisions, and Slow Falling gravity. Shown only while gliding and inside the ladder band. Useful during a pump cycle's gain phase.
config.elytra-vario.showHoldPitch.toolti: Pitch whose next-tick flight-path angle equals the current velocity angle: -atan2(vertical velocity, horizontal speed). Searches from +89° nose-down to -89° nose-up, then refines the first root. Uses current yaw and gravity with the free-flight model. Hidden without a solution or outside the ladder band. Useful during the dive.
config.elytra-vario.showOptimalPitch.too: Pitch from -89° to +89° that maximizes total-energy change (altitude + speed² / (2 × gravity)) over one physics tick. Searches whole degrees, then refines the best result. Uses current velocity, yaw, and gravity with free-flight elytra physics; excludes rockets, collisions, and Slow Falling gravity. Shown only while gliding and inside the ladder band. This is a greedy local optimum, not a whole-cycle optimum.
config.elytra-vario.showFlightPath.toolt: Current 3D velocity direction projected through the camera. Vertical distance from the crosshair shows flight-path direction relative to view pitch; horizontal distance shows sideslip. Hidden at negligible speed, behind the camera, outside the ladder band, or off-screen.
config.elytra-vario.lookaheadTicks.toolt: How long each candidate pitch is held before its total-energy change is scored. Default: 20 ticks (one second normally). Longer durations change the optimum and cost more computation.
config.elytra-vario.showMaxHorizontalSpe: Constant +53.366° pitch reference, independent of player state. At steady state: 3.38879 blocks/tick (67.776 blocks/second) horizontal and -1.00954 blocks/tick (-20.191 blocks/second) vertical. Hidden outside the marker band.
config.elytra-vario.showMinimumFallSpeed: Constant -13.233° pitch reference, independent of player state. At steady state: -0.07079 blocks/tick (-1.416 blocks/second) vertical and 0.43678 blocks/tick (8.736 blocks/second) horizontal. Hidden outside the marker band.
config.elytra-vario.showZeroPitch.toolti: Constant 0° pitch reference, independent of player state, that maximizes steady-state glide ratio. At steady state: about 10.10 blocks forward per block down, 1.51017 blocks/tick (30.203 blocks/second) horizontal, and -0.14949 blocks/tick (-2.990 blocks/second) vertical. Hidden outside the marker band.
config.elytra-vario.showChart.tooltip: Show or hide this instrument. The master HUD switch still applies. The toggle key changes and saves this setting.
config.elytra-vario.chartGlidingOnly.too: Show only while elytra gliding. This setting persists while the instrument is hidden.
config.elytra-vario.chartX.tooltip: Left edge measured from the screen's left edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.chartY.tooltip: Top edge measured from the screen's top edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.statsX.tooltip: Left edge measured from the screen's left edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.statsY.tooltip: Top edge measured from the screen's top edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.chartScale.tooltip: GUI pixels per block/tick on both axes. Bounds determine dimensions, up to 512 pixels each.
config.elytra-vario.chartMinVxz.tooltip: Axis bound in blocks per second. Minimum must be below maximum, with a span of at least 1 b/s.
config.elytra-vario.chartMaxVxz.tooltip: Axis bound in blocks per second. Minimum must be below maximum, with a span of at least 1 b/s.
config.elytra-vario.chartMinVy.tooltip: Axis bound in blocks per second. Minimum must be below maximum, with a span of at least 1 b/s.
config.elytra-vario.chartMaxVy.tooltip: Axis bound in blocks per second. Minimum must be below maximum, with a span of at least 1 b/s.
config.elytra-vario.showTrail.tooltip: Show recent horizontal and vertical velocities as a fading trail.
config.elytra-vario.chartTrailTicks.tool: History length, assuming the normal 20 ticks per second.
config.elytra-vario.trailColor.tooltip: Choose a color and opacity. Older samples fade out.
config.elytra-vario.showEnergyField.tool: Colors each velocity by its maximum one-tick total-energy gain, assuming horizontal motion follows the look direction. Excludes sideslip, rockets, and collisions.
config.elytra-vario.chartFieldScale.tool: Energy change in blocks per tick at half saturation. Color strength = |change| / (|change| + this value). Lower values emphasize near-zero changes.
config.elytra-vario.showHorizontalCursor: Horizontal coordinate = sqrt(vx² + vz²); vertical coordinate = vy.
config.elytra-vario.showForwardCursor.to: Horizontal coordinate = horizontal velocity projected onto the look direction; vertical coordinate = vy.
config.elytra-vario.showHorizontalAccele: Project the horizontal cursor's measured acceleration one second forward from the cursor.
config.elytra-vario.showForwardAccelerat: Project the forward cursor's measured acceleration one second forward from the cursor.
config.elytra-vario.showGrid.tooltip: Show the velocity grid and highlighted zero axes.
config.elytra-vario.showAxisLabels.toolt: Show axis bounds and the horizontal origin in blocks per second.

config.elytra-vario.panelWidth.tooltip: Width in GUI pixels before panel scaling.

config.elytra-vario.negativeColor.toolti: Choose a color and opacity. Colors negative vertical speed, apex differences, and cycle gain.
config.elytra-vario.title: Elytra Vario Settings
config.elytra-vario.positionMargin.toolt: Gap kept when a dragged module snaps beside another module or to a screen edge.
config.elytra-vario.positionSnapDistance: How close a dragged edge or center must be before it snaps. Set to 0 to snap only at an exact alignment. Arrow keys and coordinate fields do not snap.
config.elytra-vario.colorPicker.title: Choose %s
config.elytra-vario.range: Axis minimum must be below maximum (span ≥ 1 b/s).
config.elytra-vario.size: Each graph dimension must be 2–512 pixels.
config.elytra-vario.save_error: Could not save settings; they apply for this session only. See the game log.
config.elytra-vario.settingsKey.tooltip: Opens or closes this screen in flight. Click to set; press Escape to unbind. If unbound, use Mod Menu or the vanilla Controls screen to restore it. This vanilla key bind is stored with the game's own controls rather than with these settings, and is unaffected by Reset.
config.elytra-vario.visibilityKey.toolti: Shows or hides the entire HUD and saves the change, including while this screen is open. Click to set; press Escape to unbind. This vanilla key bind is stored with the game's own controls rather than with these settings, and is unaffected by Reset.
config.elytra-vario.toggleKey.tooltip: Shows or hides this instrument and saves the change, including while this screen is open. Click to set; press Escape to unbind. This vanilla key bind is stored with the game's own controls rather than with these settings, and is unaffected by Reset.
config.elytra-vario.keyBind.capturing: Press a key or mouse button, or Escape to unbind.
config.elytra-vario.advanced.tooltip: Show additional controls at the bottom of the page.
config.elytra-vario.reset.tooltip: Restore this page's defaults, including advanced controls.
config.elytra-vario.positionEditor.toolt:
%s
Click to open this module's settings. Drag to move and snap it. With its settings selected, use the arrow keys to move it one pixel at a time without snapping; use the coordinate fields for an exact position.
config.elytra-vario.positionEditor.contr: You can also drag and snap the module in the world preview. With its settings selected, the arrow keys move it one pixel at a time without snapping.
config.elytra-vario.showBarSpeedo.toolti: Show or hide this instrument. The master HUD switch still applies. The toggle key changes and saves this setting.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoGlidingOnly: Show only while elytra gliding. This setting persists while the instrument is hidden.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoX.tooltip: Left edge measured from the screen's left edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoY.tooltip: Top edge measured from the screen's top edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoHeight.tool: Height of the bar plot in scaled GUI pixels. Default: 96.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoMaxSpeed.to: Speed at the top of the bars; zero is at the bottom. Default: 80 b/s, just above straight-down terminal velocity. Faster bars stop at the limit and use the off-scale color.
config.elytra-vario.showBarSpeedoTotal.t: XYZ speed: sqrt(vx² + vy² + vz²). Always at least as large as either component bar.
config.elytra-vario.showBarSpeedoHorizon: XZ speed: sqrt(vx² + vz²). It coincides with total speed in level flight.
config.elytra-vario.showBarSpeedoVertica: |vy|. This bar shows magnitude only; Flight Stats' SPEED Y row shows the sign.
config.elytra-vario.showBarSpeedoAcceler: Project each bar's measured acceleration one second forward from its current speed as a centered white arrow.
config.elytra-vario.showBarSpeedoMaxHori: Thin white lines at the steady |Y|, XZ, and XYZ speeds for +53.366° flight: 20.191, 67.776, and 70.719 b/s.
config.elytra-vario.showBarSpeedoTermina: Thin gray lines at the straight-down terminal |Y|, XZ, and XYZ speeds: 78.400, 0, and 78.400 b/s. Off by default.
Label each major tick with its speed in blocks per second.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoOpacity.too: Opacity of the background behind the chart. Default: 25%.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoMajorStep.t: Spacing of the long, labeled ticks, measured from zero.
config.elytra-vario.barSpeedoPeggedColor: Choose a color and opacity. Used when a bar stops at the scale limit instead of showing an exact reading.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedo.toolt: Show or hide this instrument. The master HUD switch still applies. The toggle key changes and saves this setting.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoGlidingOnl: Show only while elytra gliding. This setting persists while the instrument is hidden.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoX.tooltip: Left edge measured from the screen's left edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoY.tooltip: Top edge measured from the screen's top edge in scaled GUI pixels. Position stays within the screen.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoRadius.too: Arc radius in scaled GUI pixels. The half disc is slightly wider than two radii and half as tall as it is wide.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoMaxSpeed.t: Speed at the arc's right end; zero is at the left. Default: 80 b/s, slightly above elytra terminal velocity. Faster needles stop at the limit and use the off-scale color.
XYZ speed: sqrt(vx² + vy² + vz²). The longest needle and always at least as large as the other two.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedoHorizo: XZ speed: sqrt(vx² + vz²). The middle-length needle; it coincides with total speed in level flight.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedoVertic: |vy|. The shortest needle; it shows magnitude only. Flight Stats' SPEED Y row shows the sign.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedoAccele: Project each needle's measured acceleration one second forward as a concentric arrow at its tip, using the needle's color.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedoMaxHor: Thin white marks across each needle's tip at the XYZ, XZ, and |Y| speeds for the steady +53.366° glide: 70.719, 67.776, and 20.191 b/s.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedoTermin: Thin gray marks across each needle's tip at the straight-down terminal XYZ, XZ, and |Y| speeds: 78.400, 0, and 78.400 b/s. Off by default.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedoLabels: Label each major tick with its speed in blocks per second.
config.elytra-vario.showDialSpeedoBorder: Outline the half disc's arc and straight lower edge.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoOpacity.to: Opacity of the half disc behind the dial. The unfilled corners remain undimmed. Default: 45%.
Spacing of the long, labeled ticks, measured from zero.
Spacing of short, unlabeled ticks from zero. Major ticks cover coincident minor ticks.
config.elytra-vario.dialSpeedoPeggedColo: Choose a color and opacity. Used when a needle stops at a scale limit instead of showing an exact reading.
